Nikita Ghosh | nikita.ghosh773@example.com | +91 9339940886
Kochi, Kerala
Open to relocating to Chennai. Notice period: 15 days.

Results-driven business development and account management professional with a focus on healthcare solutions, skilled in B2B Sales and Lead Generation using CRM and SFDC.

Senior Business Development Manager, Orbit Health — Mar 2020 - Present
Owned enterprise B2B Sales initiatives targeting private hospital chains and corporate health programs. Built a pipeline of 120+ qualified opportunities through targeted Lead Generation campaigns, converting 18 enterprise contracts worth INR 6.5 crore ARR. Implemented SFDC-driven forecasting and opportunity hygiene processes, improving sales cycle predictability by 22%. Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Agile practices to launch two new product bundles for corporate wellness, resulting in a 30% uplift in average deal size. Managed Key Account Management activities for top 10 clients, achieving 95% retention.

Account Executive, Medisure — Apr 2019 - Feb 2020
Executed territory-focused Lead Generation and outreach for SMB and mid-market healthcare providers, generating 450+ inbound and outbound leads and qualifying 60 deals in SFDC. Managed end-to-end sales cycle in CRM, reducing lead-to-demo time by 35%. Supported Key Account Management for a portfolio of 25 accounts, upselling additional services that increased account ARPU by 12%. Participated in Agile sprint planning with product and marketing to refine messaging and collateral.

Skills: B2B Sales, SFDC, Lead Generation, CRM, Key Account Management, Agile

Education: MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
